resources.string: Sign out of this session, then continue registration using the original invitation and details.
Use a recovery key here, approve this device from another trusted device, or explicitly reset your identity.
The recovery key could not be verified. Check it and try again.
Reset only if no trusted device and no recovery key are available. Resetting permanently makes old encrypted history unavailable.
Verifying this device and its security policy
Account and device security did not become ready in time. Retry to resume the same protected startup operation.
Login preparation timed out. Retry to continue.
Messages and calls will be enabled after validation and secure initialization.
The system is checking device identity, runtime environment, and security policies. Messages and calls will be enabled automatically when validation is complete.
System security approval and secure initialization
To complete device security validation, the system obtains your location once when this device is enabled to check for an unusual registration environment. It is not used for continuous tracking.
This device needs a controlled compatibility license. The security request has been submitted and is waiting for administrator approval. Keep the device online; you do not need to submit again.
This device has not passed security validation. Check the network, location permission, and device environment, or contact service support.
The security service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
Location could not be obtained. Turn on location services and try again.
Location access is required to complete device security setup.

This account already has protected data from another installation. Verify with your recovery key, or explicitly reset the encrypted identity if neither the key nor the old device is available. Security initialization remains locked until one path completes.
The device recovery request expired. Start a new verified recovery attempt.
This login has not passed the server security checks. Check the security status again. If it still fails, ask your administrator to check device authorization and the account binding.
Complete each system setting to prevent delayed messages, missed calls, or unavailable audio and video.
Required device settings are complete. Messaging and calling are now available.
The app rechecks detectable critical permissions at startup. If Android revokes one, you will be guided to restore it.
Location is collected once for device admission. Continuous background location is not enabled here.
Allow chat and call notifications. This is an app notification permission and does not read phone SMS messages.

On the system page, turn on Floating notifications, Banner, or Pop on screen for YiZhe. Without this switch, a message may make a sound and remain in the notification shade but will not appear at the top of the unlocked screen. Keep lock-screen notification content hidden.
Used for voice messages, voice calls, video calls, and Bluetooth headsets, only when you actively use those features.
Allow incoming calls to appear while the app is in the background or the device is locked. Xiaomi devices also require background activity launch.
Call alerts during Do Not Disturb
Allow YiZhe calls to ring and show accept or decline actions during system Do Not Disturb. This does not read notifications from other apps.
Set battery use to unrestricted so sleep mode does not stop message sync and call services.
Allow background services to recover after the system closes the app or the phone restarts, reducing the wait when reopening. Enable autostart for this app on the system page.
Allow background network use so data-saving policies do not block message sync or call signaling.
YiZhe does not ask you to show message notifications on the lock screen. Keep lock-screen notification content hidden to prevent names and message text from being exposed.
Complete the required settings above before submitting this device for administrator approval.
The required device settings are complete. Submit one device-security request now. Location is collected once for registration-risk validation and is not used for continuous tracking.
Create an app PIN required by the active security policy. The PIN remains protected on this device.
Choose whether anonymous diagnostic data may be shared. Declining does not reduce account or message security.
Verify this session using another trusted device or your recovery key before protected content is released.
This check starts here after the administrator approves the same device request.
The server is verifying this device and issuing an access certificate. This continues automatically.
Your organization does not allow automatic compatibility access. Contact your administrator to check the device policy.
The device security evidence did not pass verification. Update the app and check the system integrity, then try again.

Your previous installation still holds device authorization. Continue here to transfer it to this installation and disable access on the old one. You can then recover your chats or explicitly reset your encrypted identity.
Notifications are temporarily unavailable. You can keep chatting.
Matrix identity is verified. Device recovery is waiting for confirmation from a trusted old device.
Open this group invitation? Invitation permissions and expiry will be checked.
Invitation unavailable or expired. Check your connection or ask for a new invitation.
Requires confirmation on the old phone and administrator approval. The old phone stays usable until completion.
When unchecked, only ordinary chats are recovered.
Confirm this move on the old phone.
Old phone confirmed. Waiting for administrator approval.
